author: ArturCodeCraft
description: Outlined black button that scales up on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, transform becomes rotate(45deg) scale(1.08).
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Helpless Baboon 96</title>
<style>
/* Helpless Baboon 96 by ArturCodeCraft — https://uiverse.io/ArturCodeCraft/helpless-baboon-96 */
button {
  border: none;
  background: none;
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-family: inherit;
}

.menu__icon {
  width: 2rem;
  height: 2rem;
  padding: .25rem;
  backdrop-filter: saturate(180%) blur(20px);
  background-color: rgb(29, 29, 31, .7);
  border: solid 1px rgba(66,66,69,0.7);
}

.menu__icon::before {
  display: block;
  content: "+";
  color: rgb(245, 245, 247);
  font-size: 1.125rem;
  font-weight: 400;
  transition: transform .3s ease-out;
  transform-origin: center;
}

.menu__icon:hover::before {
  transform: rotate(45deg) scale(1.08);
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="menu__icon">
</button>

</body>
</html>
